blocking_issues: The mapping asserts that every value in Other_Organisation_Names is an entity.trading_name, but the source documentation explicitly says this field can contain trading names or other names. That is an unsupported legal/name-role assertion and can misclassify non-trading names. The field should be left unmapped, or mapped only with a source-faithful name role that exists in the ontology; no such alternative field is available here. It also may contain one or more names, while the mapping emits one unsplit value and has no documented source separator.

The discovery evidence reports 300 records, whereas validation reports 250 records with filtered_records=0. The mapping does not explain this 50-record coverage discrepancy. Because the mapped legal name/address observations are not conditional on ABN validity, this cannot be assumed to be caused by the ABN transform; production record coverage must be reconciled before human review can rely on the extraction.
warnings: The declared legal_entity grain is plausible but should remain explicitly limited to the ACNC charity record: the documentation establishes a charity with an ABN and a formal/legal-or-official name, but does not provide a general corporate registration type. Correctly, entity_type, status, ACN, industry code, and legal-entity registration date are not invented.

Leaving Registration_Date unmapped is semantically correct: it is the effective ACNC charity-registration date, and the documentation says pre-ACNC tax-concession registrations may be backdated to 3 December 2012; it is not established as entity.date_registered. Date_Organisation_Established is also appropriately unmapped.

The address mapping is supported as the charity's business address and preserves the separate operating-location indicators as unmapped. Some raw values are PO Boxes despite the documentation's street-address description; this is a source-data limitation, not a reason to reinterpret the address as a mailing-only address. Address_Type is not mapped into the canonical address fields, but its Business value supports the declared address role.

No status constant such as active is emitted merely because the dataset is called Registered Charities; that restraint is correct. Likewise, no unsupported AU constant is used for address.country because Country is explicitly mapped, although raw values such as Australia are not normalized to AU.

ABN digit normalization plus the authoritative ABN checksum operation is supported and the sampled values fit the ABN field semantics. The source may withhold ABNs or substitute an alternate charity-name identifier, so missing ABN observations must not be treated as evidence that the charity lacks an identifier.

The publication proxy is a defensible dataset-level observed_at fallback given the supplied metadata and lack of record timestamps, but it is not a record-level statement date. The provisional confidence values are disclosed judgements, and there is no link-confidence claim to assess because no cross-source entity link is being made.

The source is updated weekly and is a subset of the Charity Register; withheld records/fields and blank flags mean absence is not equivalent to a negative claim. The many subtype, beneficiary, operating-region, financial, and governance fields are appropriately left unmapped because the ontology has no corresponding fields.
evidence_checked: ACNC user guide December 2024, pp. 1-2 §§2-5 and §§6-15: charity-register scope, ABN, formal charity name, other organisation names, and business address semantics.
ACNC user guide p. 2 §16-17 and p. 3 §§18-24: ACNC registration date versus organisation establishment date and reporting attributes.
ACNC user guide p. 4 §§25-28: operating-location indicators and ISO alpha-3 operating countries.
ACNC user guide pp. 5-6 §§29-34: subtype and beneficiary indicators.
Observed headers and raw discovery rows, including Georges Riverkeeper as Other_Organisation_Names and PO Box values in Address_Line_1.
Trusted engine semantics for ABN validation, splitting, constants, and conditionals.
Previous mapping, validation feedback (250 records, zero filters), and discovery report (300 records).

warnings: The mapping is deliberately partial: Other_Organisation_Names is left unmapped even though documentation says it may contain trading names or other names. This is defensible because the field may contain multiple values without a documented separator and does not establish that every value is a trading name; human review may nevertheless consider a source-faithful one-value treatment if the full-file format supports it.

Registration_Date is correctly not mapped to entity.date_registered: it is the effective ACNC charity-registration date, not established here as legal-entity registration. No status is asserted, which avoids incorrectly treating inclusion in this weekly registered-charities extract as an ontology active status.

The business address mapping follows the source documentation, but discovery includes PO Boxes (for example 'Po Box 3122'); this is a source business-address field, not necessarily a physical service location or registered office. The mapping discloses this limitation and does not invent an address subtype.

The source has no reporting-group field or evidence of group membership; none is demanded or inferred. It also does not support entity_type, ACN, industry_code, or a legal-entity registration date, and leaving these unmapped is appropriate.

The supplied discovery/validation coverage is inconsistent (discovery analysis reports 300 records while validation reports 250); this is a material coverage/reconciliation limitation, but not a semantic defect in the field mappings themselves.
The dataset can omit withheld records or values, so blanks must not be interpreted as negative facts. The mapping limitations disclose this.
Confidence values are appropriately separated by claim type where used and appear to be provisional judgements; no link confidence is required because the mapping emits no cross-source entity links.
evidence_checked: ACNC User guide, Dec 2024, pp. 1-2 §§2-5, 6-17: dataset grain, ABN, formal charity/legal name, other names, business address, website, and ACNC registration date.

ACNC User guide, pp. 3-6 §§18-34: establishment date, size, responsible-person count, financial year end, operating locations, subtypes, and beneficiaries; these have no corresponding ontology fields and are explicitly left unmapped.

Raw discovery rows 2-9: one charity record per ABN, formal names, one observed Other_Organisation_Names value ('Georges Riverkeeper'), Business address type, PO Box examples, websites, and no status/reporting-group fields.
Trusted engine semantics: ABN normalization/checksum, identifier exclusivity, explicit split requirements, and constants; no unsupported constant or inferred ABN/ACN conversion is used.

Previous mapping, validation feedback, and stated limitations: filters are empty, validation passed with zero filtered records, and the publication proxy is used only as a dataset-level observed_at proxy.
